description: Stream Live IPTV, Video On-Demand, and Series from an Xtream-compatible server using this plugin. Fork of Kevinjil/Jellyfin.Xtream for Jellyfin 12.
name: Jellyfin Xtream
overview: Stream content from an Xtream-compatible server.

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.3 support (.NET 10). Fix playback of series and movies under Jellyfin 12 (non-GUID media source ids). Retry empty or failed provider answers and serve the last usable one from a memory and disk cache. Custom names for the Video On-Demand, Series and Catch-up folders.
